# Redactify — Full System Specification & Capabilities
Website: https://redactify.daeq.in

## Overview
Redactify is an AI-powered document redaction application designed for 100% in-browser processing. No files, text, or metadata are ever transmitted to any remote server during document analysis or export.

## Privacy Architecture
- Local Execution: Web Workers handle regex scanning and ONNX runtime machine learning models in browser isolation.
- Zero Data Retention: Documents exist only in volatile memory during the active session.
- Offline Capability: Operates as a Progressive Web App (PWA) without an internet connection once loaded.

## PII Detection Capabilities
1. Names, Organizations, Locations (via BERT NER ONNX model).
2. Email Addresses & Web URLs.
3. Phone Numbers (US, UK, EU, International, Indian formats).
4. Identification Numbers: US SSN, UK NINO, Canadian SIN, Australian TFN, Indian Aadhaar & PAN.
5. Banking & Financial: Credit Cards, IBAN, Bank Accounts, UPI Virtual Payment Addresses.
6. Compensation & Salaries: Currency figures in USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), INR (₹), AUD (A$), CAD (C$).

## Export Options
- PDF: Pixel-perfect page rendering with burnt-in black redaction boxes and an invisible, copyable non-PII text layer.
- DOCX: OOXML format-preserving in-place XML replacement of PII strings.
- TXT: Plain text sanitized output.

## Regulatory Compliance
Designed to fulfill strict compliance guidelines under:
- General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 32 & 25 (Privacy by Design).
- California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
- Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy Rule.
